inputLimits.inheritanceDescription: Leave blank to use the default shown in gray; 0 adds no extra limit.
inputLimits.title: Model input budgets
inputLimits.description: Budgets apply to the complete model request, including conversation history. MB = 1,000,000 bytes. Set 0 for no additional limit; leave empty to inherit. Actual model input support still applies.
inputLimits.overrideDescription: Overrides apply to every model on this upstream. Empty fields inherit the model's channel budget; select a channel to preview its values.
inputLimits.protocolDescription: Shared upstream values apply to all protocols. Protocol-specific values take precedence; empty fields inherit the next level.

conditions.openai: Official image requests allow up to 512 MB and 1,500 images. PDFs remain below 50 MB each and 50 MB total. Operating budgets may be stricter and cannot relax provider or model conditions.
conditions.google_generate_content: The 100 MB request and 200 PDF pages are current operating settings. Official inline documentation differs between 20 and 100 MB; 100 MB is not guaranteed for every endpoint. Official PDFs allow 50 MB each; model input support and context limits also apply.
conditions.gemini_interactions: The current image path uses a 100 MB operating request budget. Native PDF, audio and video input is not connected for this protocol in this application; changing budgets does not add input support.
conditions.anthropic: First-party API documentation specifies a 128 MB request, up to 600 images and 10 MB per Base64-encoded image. PDFs allow 100 or 600 pages depending on the model context; smaller windows may have stricter image counts. Verify third-party hosting separately.
conditions.openrouter: Conservative native file budgets and the 100 MB request are application protection values, not provider guarantees. Actual conditions depend on the selected model and final route.
conditions.compatible: These are application protection budgets for unverified compatible channels, not verified provider limits. Check the actual channel; model input support and provider conditions apply independently.
conditions.xai_image_edits: Image editing accepts at most 3 input images. Other budgets use compatible-channel operational defaults.
conditions.xai_video: Video generation accepts at most 1 input image. Other budgets use compatible-channel operational defaults.
conditions.openrouter_images: Image editing accepts at most 16 input images. Provider and model conditions still apply independently.

inputLimits.summaryScope: Operating budgets for the saved default chat protocol, {protocol}. Model-specific protocols and provider conditions may be stricter.
inputLimits.summaryFailed: Could not load budget summary. Open file settings to inspect it.
inputLimits.upstreamsFailed: Could not load upstreams. Channel defaults are still available.
inputLimits.invalidConfig: The saved input budget configuration is invalid. Reload after correcting it; no values have been replaced.
inputLimits.invalidValue: Enter a non-negative whole number, or MB with up to 6 decimal places.
inputLimits.fixInvalidValues: Correct invalid values before saving, including fields in other scopes.

embeddingStatus.title: Vector index status
embeddingStatus.noSignature: No signature yet. It is computed automatically after the first save.
embeddingStatus.empty: No index data yet. This appears after the embedding service is configured.
embeddingStatus.needsReindex: Stale vectors detected. Click "Index remaining" to restore retrieval.
embeddingStatus.hint: Indexing only processes unindexed, failed, stale and stalled files; ready files are never rebuilt. Files without usable text are extracted again first. Select a count to see the files and retry them individually.
embeddingStatus.runningHint: Indexing runs in the background. The status refreshes automatically until it finishes.

embeddingTasks.title: Vector index tasks
embeddingTasks.description: Review the vectorization status of files across the platform. Retry failed or stalled tasks individually; ready files are never rebuilt.

bucketHints.pending: Files that are not indexed yet, queued or processing. Tasks queued for more than 30 minutes are considered stalled and can be resubmitted; interrupted runs turn into failures within a few minutes.
bucketHints.failed: File processing or vectorization failed. Retrying extracts files that have no text yet before indexing them, and keeps the extracted text.
bucketHints.stale: The embedding model, dimensions or endpoint changed, so the old vectors of these files are no longer valid and must be rebuilt.
bucketHints.empty: Extraction finished without any text, usually scans or image-only files. After switching the OCR engine, retrying extracts them again with the new settings and keeps the result.
bucketHints.unsupported: The current configuration cannot vectorize these files, such as audio, video, or images when OCR is off and the embedding protocol has no image input. After changing the configuration, use "Index remaining" to process them.
bucketHints.ready: Files that are already vectorized, shown for reference. Files whose vector space signature changed still allow a retry.

embeddingTasks.searchPlaceholder: Search by file name or file ID
embeddingTasks.retrySkipped: Skipped {count} files that are still running or cannot be retried right now.

max_message_files.label: Attachment limit
max_message_files.description: Maximum number of attachments allowed in one chat message.

max_upload_file_bytes.label: Default size limit
max_upload_file_bytes.description: Default size limit for a single attachment. The UI uses MB.

user_storage_quota_bytes.label: User storage quota
user_storage_quota_bytes.description: Maximum total file storage per user. The UI uses MB; set 0 for unlimited.

allowed_mime_types.label: Attachment MIME allowlist
allowed_mime_types.description: Allowed attachment MIME types. Separate multiple values with commas.

image_max_bytes.label: Image size limit
image_max_bytes.description: Maximum size of one image attachment, in MB. Leave empty to use the default size limit.

doc_max_bytes.label: Document size limit
doc_max_bytes.description: Maximum size of one document attachment, in MB. Leave empty to use the default size limit.

audio_max_bytes.label: Audio size limit
audio_max_bytes.description: Maximum size of one audio attachment, in MB. Leave empty to use the default size limit.

video_max_bytes.label: Video size limit
video_max_bytes.description: Maximum size of one video attachment, in MB. Leave empty to use the default size limit.

image_max_dimension.label: Maximum image edge for sending
image_max_dimension.description: Resize the sending copy proportionally when its longest edge exceeds this pixel count. Set 0 to disable local resizing; the stored original is preserved.

prepared_image_cache_max_entries.label: Cached image count
prepared_image_cache_max_entries.description: Maximum cached image processing results; 0 disables caching. Eviction keeps the stored original.

prepared_image_cache_max_bytes.label: Prepared image cache size
prepared_image_cache_max_bytes.description: Maximum total image processing cache size, in MB; 0 disables caching.

temporary_chat_max_attachments.label: Request attachment count
temporary_chat_max_attachments.description: Maximum attachments across one temporary chat request. Per-message upload attachment limits still apply.

temporary_chat_request_max_bytes.label: Base request budget
temporary_chat_request_max_bytes.description: Base JSON request body limit for temporary chats, in MB. Multipart uploads additionally include the applicable attachment budget.

image_attachment_processor_max_bytes.label: Total image tool input
image_attachment_processor_max_bytes.description: Combined prepared image size sent to image tools, in MB; 0 adds no limit.

image_attachment_analysis_max_chars.label: Single image analysis
image_attachment_analysis_max_chars.description: Maximum returned analysis characters per image; 0 adds no limit.

image_attachment_analysis_total_max_char.label: Total image analysis
image_attachment_analysis_total_max_char.description: Maximum returned analysis characters across all images; 0 adds no limit.

generated_image_max_bytes.label: Generated image save limit
generated_image_max_bytes.description: Maximum downloaded size of one generated image saved to file storage, in MB.

full_context_limit_enabled.label: Full-text injection limits
full_context_limit_enabled.description: When enabled, full-text injection is limited by size in MB, token budget, and PDF pages. When disabled, these limits are ignored.

file_full_context_max_bytes.label: Full-text size limit
file_full_context_max_bytes.description: Maximum extracted text size for full-text injection of one file, in MB. Leave empty or use 0 for no size limit.
file_full_context_max_bytes.placeholder: Size limit (MB); empty or 0 means unlimited

full_context_max_tokens.label: Full-text token limit
full_context_max_tokens.description: Maximum token count for full-text injection of one file. Leave empty or use 0 for no token limit.

full_context_pdf_max_pages.label: Full-text page limit
full_context_pdf_max_pages.description: Maximum pages for full-text injection of one PDF. Leave empty or use 0 for no page limit.

embedding_enabled.label: Enable Embedding
embedding_enabled.description: Enable file vectorization and vector retrieval. Related pipelines are disabled when this is off.

embedding_host.label: Embedding service URL *
embedding_host.description: Base URL of the Embedding service, for example https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta.

embedding_protocol.label: Request protocol
embedding_protocol.description: Wire format of the Embedding service. Gemini, Voyage, and Jina accept image inputs, so images are vectorized directly instead of through OCR text.

embedding_key.label: Embedding auth key
embedding_key.description: Auth key used when calling the Embedding service.

embedding_timeout_seconds.label: Embedding timeout
embedding_timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait time for one Embedding API request, in seconds.

embedding_output_dimensions.label: Vector dimensions
embedding_output_dimensions.description: Vector dimensions used consistently for storage and retrieval.

embedding_dimensions_policy.label: Dimensions request policy
embedding_dimensions_policy.description: Whether to include the `dimensions` parameter in requests. Some services reject it.

embedding_normalize.label: Normalize vectors
embedding_normalize.description: Normalize vectors before storage and retrieval.

embed_trigger_on_upload.label: Auto-vectorize
embed_trigger_on_upload.description: Trigger Embedding asynchronously after file upload completes.

embed_batch_size.label: Batch size
embed_batch_size.description: Number of text chunks sent in one Embedding API request.

embed_chunk_size_tokens.label: Chunk size
embed_chunk_size_tokens.description: Document vectorization chunk size, estimated by tokens.

rag_top_k.label: Retrieved chunks
rag_top_k.description: Number of RAG chunks returned and injected.

ocr_response_max_bytes.label: OCR response read limit
